The '''LCK 2024 Summer Split''' was the second split of the 2024 season of the [[League of Legends Champions Korea]], organized by Riot Games. The competition ran from June 12 to September 8, with the Regular Season held offline at LoL Park in Seoul, the T1 Homeground at Goyang Sono Arena, and the Lower Bracket Final and Grand Final at Gyeongju Indoor Stadium. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Regular Season using best-of-three matches, with the top six advancing to a Double Elimination Playoffs played as best-of-five. The winner qualified for the [[World Championship/2024|World Championship]]. The split was played across patches 14.11 through 14.16, with Lee Sin and Aurora disabled at various points for competitive reasons.

==Format==
*'''Regular Season''' - ''June 12<sup>th</sup> - August 18<sup>th</sup>, 2024''
**Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to Round 2 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 10th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 23<sup>rd</sup> - September 8<sup>th</sup>, 2024''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2024|Worlds 2024]]
